title: AI-Equipped Garbage Trucks Could Soon Start Spying On People in the US - Slashdot

content_html:
America's garbage trucks can do more than just collect trash, reports Newsweek. They may also help identify code violations using AI. Officials in Cape Coral, Florida, recently considered equipping sanitation trucks with AI-powered cameras that would photograph properties as crews complete their normal collection routes. The system would have been designed to identify potential issues such as overgrown lawns, peeling paint, and illegal dumping, and to flag violations so the city staff can review them later before taking enforcement action... However, in a statement on July 13, Cape Coral officials said it would not be moving forward with the camera technology, citing cost issues and insufficient benefits.

"Claims suggesting that this technology would automatically identify, cite or fine residents are inaccurate," the statement also noted... Cape Coral officials say that a camera system in the future would assist — not replace — human code enforcement officers, and employees will review any AI-generated alerts before violations are issued. "Even if such a system were to be considered in the future, any potential code violations would require review and verification by a Code Compliance Officer before any enforcement action could be taken," the organization wrote.


But Cape Coral, Florida "is not the first city to explore the technology," the article notes. AI imaging systems developed by City Detect have already been deployed in several municipalities. According to the company's published case studies, Stockton, California, used the platform to analyze nearly 40,000 parcels, capturing almost 200,000 images while identifying thousands of potential code issues. Cathedral City, California, has also used the technology to assist code enforcement, while Dallas approved funding for a similar program pending final implementation.
Thanks to Slashdot reader fjo3 for sharing the article.

content_html_zh: 据《新闻周刊》报道，美国的垃圾车不仅仅可以收集垃圾。 他们还可以使用人工智能帮助识别代码违规行为。 佛罗里达州珊瑚角的官员最近考虑为环卫卡车配备人工智能摄像头，当工作人员完成正常的收集路线时，这些摄像头可以拍摄财产。 该系统的设计目的是识别潜在问题，例如杂草丛生、油漆剥落和非法倾倒，并标记违规行为，以便城市工作人员可以在采取执法行动之前对其进行审查...... 然而，珊瑚角官方在 7 月 13 日的一份声明中表示，由于成本问题和效益不足，不会继续推进相机技术。 声明还指出：“声称这项技术会自动识别、引用或罚款居民的说法是不准确的。” 珊瑚角官员表示，未来的摄像头系统将协助（而不是取代）人类代码执行人员，员工将在发布违规行为之前审查任何人工智能生成的警报。 该组织写道：“即使将来考虑建立这样的系统，任何潜在的代码违规行为都需要代码合规官进行审查和验证，然后才能采取任何执法行动。” 但文章指出，佛罗里达州珊瑚角“并不是第一个探索这项技术的城市”。 City Detect开发的人工智能成像系统已在多个城市部署。 根据该公司发布的案例研究，加利福尼亚州斯托克顿使用该平台分析了近 40,000 个包裹，捕获了近 200,000 张图像，同时识别了数千个潜在的代码问题。 加利福尼亚州大教堂城也使用该技术来协助法规执行，而达拉斯则批准为类似计划提供资金，等待最终实施。 感谢 Slashdot 读者 fjo3 分享文章。
